claim: Schema discipline: belief provenance is carried by an artifact field; contract-grade is derived, not stored - a prescription with non-empty rules/invariants is contract-grade (Belief.contract?/1) and no contract field is carried; the implication field is absent; enum-shaped fields (kind, domain, artifact-scheme) take values from b039/b041/b043 respectively; kind binds allowed structural types via the kind-type derivation table.
rules: The artifact field is the canonical provenance carrier on beliefs. Its value is null or a string matching scheme:id where scheme is declared by b043.
The kind field's value is null or one of the values declared by b039.
The domain field's value is null or one of the values declared by b041.
The contract field is absent on all beliefs; contract-grade is computed from rules/invariants on read (Belief.contract?/1), never stored.
A belief is contract-grade iff rules or invariants are non-empty - the definition of the predicate, formerly enforced as a stored-field biconditional.
The implication field is absent on all beliefs.
Beliefs with kind: action-item have type: prescription and empty rules/invariants.
The four structural types are distinct and are not merged: an aggregation states exactly what its deps jointly state, an inference may exceed them, a prescription prescribes.
Artifacts (external documents, threads, files) are not promoted to belief nodes; they are referenced via the artifact field only.
invariants: For all beliefs b: contract?(b) implies b.type == 'prescription'.
For all beliefs b: contract?(b) iff ((b.rules // []) ++ (b.invariants // [])) non-empty.
For all beliefs b: b.artifact == null OR b.artifact matches /^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*:.+/.
For all beliefs b: b.kind == null OR b.kind is in b039.enum.
For all beliefs b: b.artifact == null OR scheme(b.artifact) is in b043.enum.
For all beliefs b: b.domain == null OR b.domain is in b041.enum.
For all beliefs b: b does not have an `implication` field.
For all beliefs b: b does not have a `contract` field.
For all beliefs b with b.kind == 'action-item': b.type == 'prescription' AND (b.rules // []) is empty AND (b.invariants // []) is empty.

evidence.detail: Accepted via human adjudication against cb:b038. Reasoning: cb-schema-v2: schema discipline restated for four types; contract attaches to directive; the stale b040 scheme-enum reference is corrected to its successor b043; the kind-type table joins the enum family.

Retro-pair per the b507 close protocol: the session slug this node stipulates from is readable in the thread record - the schema-landing main body and postscripts 2-6 cover the stasis, observability, and ceremony exchanges where these stipulations were made.

The stored contract boolean was demoted to a derived predicate: contract-grade is computed as rules/invariants non-empty (Belief.contract?/1) and the contract field was stripped from the 39 nodes carrying it (zero drift measured against the former biconditional). This contract's rules/invariants now state the biconditional as the definition of the predicate.
